build_tool_grammar: build an xgrammar EBNF grammar string from a list of Cohere normalized tool definitions using collect_tool_schema
convert_to_structural_tags: convert a JSON schema and tool definitions into an xgrammar structural tag response format string for Cohere models
normalize_tool_definitions: normalize tool definitions from various formats into a list of CohereNormalizedTool dicts using _tool_definitions_to_schema_list
extract_reasoning_from_output: extract reasoning and content from a model output string using BaseCohereCommandReasoningParser extract_reasoning method
adjust_chat_request: adjust a ChatCompletionRequest by converting JSON schema and tools into structural tags using BaseCohereCommandReasoningParser adjust_request method
